What it does

This law amends the definition of 'person' in Tennessee Code Annotated Section 1-3-105(a). It states that a person includes a corporation, firm, company, or association, but does not include artificial intelligence, a computer algorithm, a software program, computer hardware, or any type of machine.

Who it applies to

  • The definition of 'person' in Tennessee Code Annotated Section 1-3-105(a), which governs the meaning of that term in Title 1 of the Tennessee Code Annotated.

Effective date

Upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it (Sec. 2).

Key definitions

  • Person: includes a corporation, firm, company, or association; does not include artificial intelligence, a computer algorithm, a software program, computer hardware, or any type of machine (Sec. 1, amending Tenn. Code Ann. § 1-3-105(a)(20)).

Obligations

  • None stated in the text.

Prohibitions

  • Artificial intelligence, a computer algorithm, a software program, computer hardware, or any type of machine cannot be considered a 'person' under Tennessee Code Annotated Section 1-3-105(a) (Sec. 1).

Penalties and enforcement

Not stated in the text. The law does not specify an enforcement agency, penalties, or a private right of action.

How it affects AI deployment

  • Organizations deploying artificial intelligence in Tennessee must not treat the AI system, its algorithms, software, or hardware as a legal person under Title 1 of the Tennessee Code Annotated (Sec. 1).
  • The deploying organization, if it is a corporation, firm, company, or association, remains a person and can hold legal rights and obligations, but the AI itself cannot (Sec. 1).

Notable exemptions

  • None stated in the text.

Compliance steps

  • Ensure that the term 'person' in any Tennessee Code Annotated Title 1 context is not applied to artificial intelligence, computer algorithms, software programs, computer hardware, or machines (Sec. 1).

AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 1, relative to certain conditions of personhood.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

 SECTION 1. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 1-3-105(a), is amended by deleting
subdivision (20) and substituting:

 (20) "Person":

 (A) Includes a corporation, firm, company, or association; and

 (8) Does not include artificial intelligence, a computer algorithm, a software
 program, computer hardware, or any type of machine;

 SECTION 2. This act takes effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it.
